{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches only release notes as part of a code change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Release note updates accompanying a functional change are reviewed as part of that change's category, not docs."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches kernel headers solely to remove the expiry option and removal reason enum entries.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The kernel changes are mechanical follow-ups to removing expiry in the mempool rather than an alteration to kernel API boundaries or library decoupling."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Mempool label and fundamentally alters mempool eviction rules and data structures in src/txmempool.cpp and src/txmempool.h.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Removes incentive-incompatible age-based eviction that can drop still-mineable transactions like low-feerate parents waiting on CPFP (issue #33510). It also eliminates an ordered-tree index per entry, reducing memory overhead so more transactions fit under the memory cap."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Deletes mempool_expiry.py and updates existing functional and fuzz tests to accommodate the removal of mempool expiry.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The modifications to functional tests and fuzz harnesses follow the mempool policy change directly and do not alter general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp only to deprecate the -mempoolexpiry command-line option.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Settings changes whose primary purpose is to configure or retire an area's specific behavior belong to that area rather than utils."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validation.cpp to remove the invocation of expiry checks.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to validation files that simply remove mempool policy eviction calls belong to mempool rather than validation."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/wallet_resendwallettransactions.py only to adapt the test to the removal of mempool expiry.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Updating a wallet functional test as a consequence of changed mempool eviction semantics does not constitute a wallet change."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
